meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会在指定群组里搭一套持久化 wiki 知识库：创建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录、初始 index.md 和 log.md，写入维护 wiki 的容器技能，并在群组 CLAUDE.md 中加入 wiki 段落，之后按摄入、查询、检查维护它。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词时触发，进入搭建流程。

say.text: 帮我给这个群组加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: Claude 先读 LLM Wiki 模式，再问你放哪个群组

say.text: 把这份 PDF 摄入 wiki 知识库
say.note: 它一次只处理一个来源，逐页更新 wiki

say.text: 给这个 wiki 安排每月一次健康检查
say.note: 用 schedule_task 排定 lint 任务

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: it creates wiki/ and sources/ dirs with initial index.md and log.md, writes a wiki container skill, and adds a wiki section to the group's CLAUDE.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "add wiki", "wiki", or "knowledge base".

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: Claude reads the LLM Wiki pattern, then asks which group

say_en.text: Ingest this PDF into the wiki
say_en.note: It handles sources one at a time and updates the wiki

say_en.text: Schedule a monthly wiki health check
say_en.note: Sets up a recurring lint task
